finding: A valid D015 buyer-initiated trade result is not applied to the same raw trade when D016 or D120 is materialised through the public owner seam. The derived sign D015 is keyed by its own hashed derived-occurrence ID while D016/D120 look it up under the M00 trade observation occurrence ID, which is a distinct identity namespace. Both rows persist zero as a successful canonical result despite complete contemporaneous trade/quote inputs, instead of applying sign=+1 to size=2 and trade_price=6, multiplier=100. This violates Stage-1 signed-trade arithmetic and exact raw-to-derived lineage compatibility. It is a distinct concrete manifestation of the previously recurrent R/D graph-selection and lineage class.
first_failed_invariant: A per-trade D015 classification must be correlated to the original trade observation(s) it classified, via provable raw lineage; no join may rely on equality between unrelated M00 and Dxxx occurrence-ID namespaces. When correlation cannot be established, fail closed rather than persisting a fabricated zero.
